entities.name: Locarno–Ponte Brolla–Bignasco line
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Locarno-Ponte Brolla-Bignasco railway (LPB), also known as Valmaggina, was a narrow-gauge railway that connected the center of Locarno and Lake Maggiore with Bignasco, through the Vallemaggia. The starting station was Locarno Sant'Antonio.
